author: Kushal
problem: Read an integer n (1 to 10^9) and print Yes if 2^n is greater than n^2, otherwise No.
bug_description: Only n = 2 and 3 are treated as No; n = 4 (where 2^4 equals 4^2) is missed, so it prints Yes.

comments.accurate: Prints Yes when 2^n is strictly greater than n^2, using the small-n exceptions instead of computing powers
comments.wrong_behavior: Prints No for n = 2 and n = 3, where n^2 overtakes 2^n, and Yes for every other n
comments.wrong_location: Small-n cases verified; check the int() parse for very large n

source.fixed_line: if n == 2 or n == 3 or n == 4:
